_comment: OSHWA/OKH-style open-hardware air-filter (and one sensing companion) shortlist for Agent-1. Agent-1 picks 2-3 entries fabricable on current Fab Lab Bali inventory by matching `fabricable_with` tags. Specs below are summarised from the linked open documentation; anything not independently verified for the Bali context is flagged 'verify'. NOTE: the Corsi-Rosenthal Box, Nukit, and the simple single-filter box-fan are particulate AIR FILTERS (the advisory's mitigation hardware); AirGradient is an open MONITOR included as a sensing companion to corroborate/track PM2.5 around a hub, NOT a filter. MERV-13 filters and 50/60Hz box fans are import items in Indonesia — local availability is the main fabrication unknown (flagged).

filters.name: Corsi-Rosenthal Box
filters.bom_summary: 1x 20-inch box fan + 4-5x 20x20-inch MERV-13 HVAC filters forming a cube, duct tape, cardboard shroud. ~600-800 CFM, ~USD 65 in materials (US pricing).
filters.notes: Widely documented open design (Corsi & Rosenthal, 2020); peer-reviewed performance characterisation exists (Aerosol Sci. & Tech. 2022). Lowest-skill build. verify: MERV-13 filter + 50Hz box-fan local availability/pricing in Bali; a single-filter variant (see diy_box_fan_single) is cheaper if filters are scarce.

filters.name: Nukit Open Air Purifier (Tempest / Brisa)
filters.bom_summary: Laser-cut frame (DXF provided) + 1x 2x20x20-inch MERV-13 furnace filter + 140mm PC fans + 12V PSU + 5.5mm barrel-to-4pin-PWM adapter + fan grills. Wall, hanging, or tower variants.
filters.notes: Open hardware, GPLv3 (design by Naomi Wu). Parametric web builder at FilterBoxBuilder.com generates cut files. Good fit for a fab lab with a laser cutter; quieter per CADR than the box fan. verify: 140mm fan + MERV-13 (2-inch) stock locally; DXF assumes North American 20x20 filter sizing.

filters.name: Single-filter box-fan purifier (taped MERV filter)
filters.bom_summary: 1x box fan + 1x 20x20-inch MERV-13 (or highest MERV available) filter taped to the intake side. Lower CADR than the cube but far fewer filters.
filters.notes: The minimal precursor to the Corsi-Rosenthal cube; documented by UC Davis Western Center for Ag Health & Safety. Listed as the lowest-BOM fallback when MERV-13 filters are scarce/expensive in Bali. verify: airflow drops markedly with a single high-MERV filter — confirm acceptable CADR for the target room size.

filters.name: AirGradient DIY Open Air Quality Monitor (sensing companion, not a filter)
filters.bom_summary: Open-hardware PM2.5/CO2/temp/RH monitor: ESP-based D1 Mini + PMS5003 PM sensor (+ CO2/SHT modules on Pro), AirGradient PCB (KiCad/Gerber open) or PCB-free wiring, 3D-printed enclosure (STEP files open).
filters.notes: MIT-licensed open hardware; full schematics, KiCad files, and enclosure STEP files published. Included as a corroborating/low-cost sensing node around a hub to validate the PM2.5 trigger and extend coverage — it is NOT mitigation hardware, so Agent-1 should pair it with at least one actual filter in any advisory. Data can post to any backend (relevant to the sovereign-store plan).
